tldr: Jupiter in Leo: growth comes through visible self-expression, generosity, and creative confidence.
body: With Jupiter in Leo, expansion works through creativity, celebration, leadership, and the courage to be seen. What grows is whatever gets shared with an audience of any size.
gift: Generosity, creative confidence, warmth, and the ability to make others feel included in the win.
challenge: Pride, overpromising, and measuring the work by the applause it gets.
